address: Rue du Vieux Four 53, Aire-la-Ville, 1288, Switzerland
bio: A sleepy village deep in the countryside is the venue of this pleasant guesthouse that extends a warm authentic welcome. Take a seat on the pretty terrace surrounded by meadows and breathe in the fresh air. You can expect regional seasonal fare, steeped in big-boned aromas and washed down with a fine selection of wines from the Geneva area....
